outputs: Generated answers for multiple-choice and free-response questions
Token-level confidence scores for generated answers
The models generate responses to instructions, including multiple-choice and free-response outputs, which are evaluated for calibration and accuracy.

changes_made.explanation: Normalized model names to standard capitalization, removed duplicate Llama-2-Chat-7B entries, simplified Alpaca dataset name, and streamlined outputs descriptions.
Normalized metric names to canonical forms and removed duplicates. Kept base forms of metrics (ECE becomes Expected Calibration Error).
No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted in this paper. The paper focuses on calibration metrics, not using LLMs to evaluate generated outputs.
No human evaluation was conducted in this paper. Evaluation was entirely based on automatic calibration metrics.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on calibration methods for LLMs rather than traditional NLG evaluation. The extracted metadata was generally accurate but needed normalization for consistency. The paper evaluates calibration using standard metrics but does not evaluate the quality of generated text content using human or LLM judges.
